description: Search Google's live GoogleAdsField catalog. Discovers every queryable GAQL resource, attribute, segment, metric, enum value, and selectable-with compatibility relationship. Read-only and useful before a raw GAQL query.

category.description: Category selected from the provider dictionary or field catalogue.

filterable.description: Filter the field catalogue by whether the field can appear in WHERE.

nameContains.description: Case-sensitive field-name substring, e.g. conversion or asset_group

pageSize.description: Maximum items requested per page. Follow the returned pagination information for remaining results.

pageToken.description: Opaque continuation token returned by the preceding provider response.

query.description: Optional raw GoogleAdsField SELECT query. When provided it replaces the structured filters.

selectable.description: Filter the field catalogue by whether the field can appear in SELECT.

sortable.description: Filter the field catalogue by whether the field can appear in ORDER BY.

name: google_ads_search_fields

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

title: google ads search fields
